title: Lee as the comic, Lester as straight man, Irma leaving music
summary: Lee played the comedian while Lester was straight man, and Irma stopped playing and went into singing and dancing.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Uh huh. You mentioned that you and Lester and Irma danced and sang, and you mentioned that you were doing comedy; did Lester and Irma also do comedy, or was that strictly for you?
No, that was me. Lester would always be the straight man, you know, and I was the comedian because I was, I guess, more of a flake. It would be termed now, you know?
Did Irma give up music for good?
And that was fairly young, wasn't it? When you went to Los Angeles, right?
Right. Yeah, she didn't play any more, and then she started dancing and singing and she worked quite a few places.
